ImageDescription.value:
Crowds of people on Santa Monica Beach, ca.1900
Photograph of crowds of people (mostly bathers, many with umbrellas) on the Santa Monica beach, ca.1900. A row of buildings lines the boardwalk. A pier is visible behind the people. An American flag flies from a flagpole. Legible signs include: "Bowling alley, shooting gallery", "Arcadia Bath House, clean smooth safe beach, Arcadia Grill Room"..., "Milkshake, lemonade"..., "Bicycle riding prohibited on walk".
